info.title: Sourcing Evidence API
info.description: Independent synthetic-data prototype. A conditional cost-driver scenario; never supplier approval or a verified should-cost estimate.

get.summary: List the fictional cases and this browser's saved review of each

post.summary: Open a case: resume its review or create one

404.description: `review_not_found`: this browser has no review of the case.

409.description: `stale_review`: the review changed since `expected_version`; nothing was written. `history_full`: the history limit is reached; restart the case.

422.description: `invalid_request`: the body does not match the schema. Other codes (`matches_source`, `citation_does_not_state_value`, `review_blocked`, ...) reject a change that is not allowed in the current review state.

500.description: `stored_review_invalid`: the saved review failed validation and is not served.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Facts this issue refers to; each has its own source reference.

CaseHeader.title: CaseHeader
CaseHeader.description: Observed quotation facts. Available even while the derived calculation is withheld.

CorrectionInput.title: CorrectionInput
CorrectionInput.description: A deliberate reviewer override. Nothing is prefilled or inferred by the service.

citation_mentions_value.title: Citation Mentions Value
citation_mentions_value.description: Text match only. It is not a judgement that the passage supports the override.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Every error from the public demonstration has this shape.

source_value.title: Source Value
source_value.description: As stated in the document; null when it states no usable value.

reviewer_value.title: Reviewer Value
reviewer_value.description: The reviewer's override, if any. Never replaces source_value.

effective_value.title: Effective Value
effective_value.description: The value the reviewed calculation uses.

latest_what_if_event_matches_result.title: Latest What If Event Matches Result

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: Where a value is stated: document identity, page, line and the exact line text.

held_movement_pct.title: Held Movement Pct
held_movement_pct.description: This driver's own movement under the stated basis.

required_movement_pct.title: Required Movement Pct
required_movement_pct.description: Movement of this driver alone that reaches the proposed price, the other three held.
